notes: Revenue = continuing operations as most recently restated (ex-Russian Yandex businesses and ex-Toloka, which became discontinued in 2025). Q1'24 9.7 derived as restated H1'24 24.2 (Q2'25 6-K) minus restated Q2'24 14.5; Q3'24 32.1 and Q4'24 35.2 are restated figures from the Q3'25/Q4'25 6-Ks (originally reported 43.3/37.9 incl. Toloka); Q1'25 restated 50.9 (originally 55.3). Q3'22-Q4'23 set to null: no restated ex-Toloka quarterly figures exist in filings (2023 comparatives in 2024 releases still include Toloka, and pre-2024 Yandex quarterly results are not comparable). Only 10 non-null quarters / 6 YoY points are computable. No quarterly guidance; FY26 guide revenue $3.0-3.4B, ARR $7-9B (reaffirmed 2026-08-12) so provides_guidance=true. Gross margin 77.1% = (revenue - cost of revenues)/revenue, where cost of revenues EXCLUDES D&A (total D&A was 44.6% of Q2 revenue); a D&A-burdened gross margin would be far lower. Adjusted operating margin not reported (adj. EBITDA margin 40.6%). TTM: OCF ~5,258 (inflated by customer prepayments; deferred revenue $5.98B) minus capex ~11,142 on TTM revenue 1,355.1. Net cash = cash 8,042.1 - debt (mostly converts) 8,545.7 at 6/30/26, excluding $1.51B operating leases and the $775M secured facility raised July 2026. Revenue model classed usage (GPU cloud capacity) although much is contracted 1-3yr or long-term with prepayments (~70% of Q2 deals). Founder Arkady Volozh controls ~52% of votes. heavy_dilution: H1'26 ATM sales of 12.7M Class A shares for ~$2.85B gross plus $4.34B of convertible notes issued in H1'26. ttm_pe null: Nebius reports adjusted net loss, not adjusted EPS; TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26) adjusted net loss = FY25 $(446.7)M - H1'25 $(175.2)M + H1'26 $(133.5)M = $(405.0)M, so it is loss-making. eps_growth_ttm_pct null: TTM is a loss and the prior TTM also includes adjusted losses (Q4'24 $(69.0)M + H1'25 $(175.2)M; Q3'24 not checked). market_cap_musd from SA $66.6B.
